svg.text: Section B–B | Longitudinal bay at X=0 (17 mm; same Z datums at 16 mm)
Solid edges: exact retained BRep intersections sampled ≤0.1 mm. Dashed rectangles: named external envelopes/projections.
Fly EZmate plug: Z8.10–9.40; board bottom Z10; mated stack 1.90, floor gap 6.10.
Under Main: 8.00 mm gross height; three bosses and source case/splice hardware are subtracted in volume budget.
Rack top is Z22.20 (20.20 mm part height above Z2), not a Z20.20 top datum.
USB overmold top Z16.32 requires a small open nose/setback; a roof cannot occupy its insertion envelope.
